title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1986-06-22
lineage: Sony SL-HF900 Betamax > Sony PCM-601ESD SPDIF out > RME DIGI9652 sound card SPDF in > Wavelab 4 wav file
source: Schoeps CMC42 (Spread Omnis, Spaced 3 Feet Apart with 180 degree angle of incidence) -> Grace 18v Mic Preamp -> MOD PCM-F1, Recording Location: Official Tapers Section

ai_review.summary: Good recording captures a solid ’86 show with a standout Box of Rain finale and strong second‑set energy.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate the performance four stars, noting an unremarkable first set that really picks up after the space jam, highlighted by Jerry’s heavy chord work and a perfect closing Box of Rain. The recording is described as good overall with no major flaws, making it a worthwhile download for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 4‑star reviews point to a solid musical performance and a good‑quality recording; weighted average yields an overall 4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as a good recording with no specific sound issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is decent but not exceptional; energy climbs after the space segment with heavy Jerry chords, a lively second half and a perfect closing Box of Rain.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Plays lots of fast, heavy chords especially after the space jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides sweet summertime antics during Lovelight; funny but head‑scratching moments noted.
